title: How Many Tiles in a Box? Coverage by Tile Size
description: Tiles per box vary by size and brand, but the label always gives pieces and square feet. Convert between them, see per-tile coverage by size and why grout helps.

title: How Much Paint Do You Need for Kitchen Cabinets?
description: Most kitchens need about a gallon of primer and one to two gallons of cabinet paint for two coats. An estimating method by linear feet of cabinets, with a chart.

title: How Many Rolls of Wallpaper Do I Need? Count Strips, Not Square Feet
description: Count wallpaper the way installers do: strips around the room, strips per roll from the wall height and pattern repeat. Charts by room and a worked example.

title: How Much Grout Do You Need? Pounds per 100 Sq Ft by Tile Size
description: Grout depends on tile size, joint width and tile thickness. The formula, a chart in pounds per 100 sq ft, and why small tiles and wide joints take far more grout.

title: Stair Rise and Run: Code Limits and Comfortable Dimensions
description: The IRC allows risers up to 7 3/4 in and treads down to 10 in, but comfortable stairs sit nearer 7 in by 11 in. The rules of thumb, with a chart and an example.

title: Wallpaper Pattern Repeat: Straight, Half-Drop and the Paper It Wastes
description: What the pattern repeat on a wallpaper label means, how straight and half-drop matches change strip length, and how many extra rolls a large repeat costs.

title: Carpet Roll Widths: 12, 13.5 and 15 ft, and Where Seams Go
description: Most carpet comes 12 ft wide; some comes 13.5 or 15 ft. How roll width changes the square yards you buy and the number of seams, with a chart by room size.

title: Gravel Driveway Depth and Layers: How Much Stone to Order
description: A durable gravel driveway is built in layers 8 to 12 inches deep in total. Layers, tons of stone per layer for common driveway sizes, and how to stop ruts.

title: How Deep Should Mulch Be? 2 to 4 Inches, and Why Not More
description: Wood chip and bark mulch works best 2 to 4 inches deep, kept clear of trunks. Depth by situation, what each extra inch costs and how to top up.

title: How Much Paint for a 12x12 Room? Coverage Chart by Room Size
description: A 12x12 room with 8 ft walls takes about 2 gallons of paint for two coats. See the coverage chart for 10x10 to 20x20 rooms, with and without the ceiling.

title: Privacy Fence Materials List for 100 Feet
description: Everything to buy for a 100 ft, 6 ft tall wood privacy fence with a gate: posts, rails, pickets, concrete, gravel and fasteners, with the math behind each line.

title: How Many Sheets of Drywall for a 12x12 Room?
description: A 12x12 room with 8 ft walls takes 12 sheets of 4x8 drywall for the walls and 5 for the ceiling. See counts for 9 and 10 ft walls and 4x12 sheets.

title: How Many Fence Pickets Do I Need? Count per Section and per Foot
description: Divide the fence length in inches by picket width plus gap. Picket counts per 6 and 8 ft section for 1×4 and 1×6 boards, with a full-fence example.

title: Deck Joist Spacing: 12, 16 or 24 Inches?
description: Joist spacing depends on the decking. 16 in suits most 5/4 wood and composite boards, 12 in suits diagonal layouts and 24 in suits 2x decking. IRC tables and counts.

title: How Many Deck Boards Do I Need? Count by Rows, Not Area
description: Count deck boards row by row: rows from the board width plus gap, boards per row from the board length. Includes a chart of the best board length for each deck size.

title: How Much Sand Do You Need Under Pavers?
description: Pavers sit on a 1 inch layer of bedding sand over a compacted gravel base. How much sand and base to order for a patio, by size, in yards, tons and bags.

title: 40 lb vs 60 lb vs 80 lb Concrete Bags: Yield and Cost
description: How much concrete each bag size makes, how many bags fill a cubic yard, how to compare cost per cubic foot, and when 80 lb bags are worth the weight.

title: How Many Bundles of Shingles in a Square?
description: Most asphalt shingles come 3 bundles to a 100 sq ft square; some heavier lines take 4 or 5. A bundle chart by roof size, with waste, ridge cap and starter.

title: How Many Bricks per Square Foot? Modular, Queen and King
description: About 6.75 modular bricks cover a square foot of wall with 3/8 inch joints. Bricks per sq ft for common sizes, the math behind it and wall examples.

title: How Much Soil Do I Need for a Raised Bed?
description: Length × width × depth gives cubic feet of soil. A 4×8 bed 12 in deep holds 32 cu ft. Charts by bed size and depth, bags vs bulk and a three-bed example.

title: How to Calculate Stair Stringer Length
description: Stringer length is the number of risers times one step's diagonal. The formula, a chart by total rise, board length to buy and the wood left after cutting.

title: How Many Concrete Blocks Do I Need? Courses and Blocks per Foot
description: A standard 8×8×16 block covers 0.89 sq ft, so a wall takes 1.125 blocks per sq ft. Count by courses, see a chart of common walls and mortar bags.

title: Fence Post Spacing: 6 or 8 Feet Apart?
description: Wood fence posts usually go 8 ft apart to match 8 ft rails; 6 ft is stiffer for heavy or windy fences. What each costs in posts, rails and concrete.

title: How Much Mulch Do I Need? Cubic Yards and Bags by Area
description: Square feet × depth in inches ÷ 324 gives cubic yards of mulch. Charts by area for 2, 3 and 4 inch depths, bag counts and a whole-yard example.

title: How Much Mortar Do I Need for Brick or Block?
description: About 8 cu ft of mortar per 1,000 modular bricks, or one 80 lb bag for up to 37 bricks or 13 blocks. Bag charts, mortar types and mixing tips.

title: How Much Does a Cubic Yard of Gravel Weigh?
description: A cubic yard of gravel weighs about 1.3 to 1.5 tons. See weights for crushed stone, crusher run, pea gravel, sand and topsoil, and convert yards to tons.

title: How Much Carpet Do I Need? Square Yards from a 12 ft Roll
description: Room square feet ÷ 9 gives square yards, but carpet is cut from 12 ft rolls, so you buy more. How to work out what you'll pay for, with a chart by room size.

title: Primer and Second Coats: When Paint Coverage Changes
description: When you need primer, when one coat is enough and when to plan three. How each choice changes the gallons for a room, with a decision table and an example.

title: Roof Pitch Multiplier Chart: Turn a Footprint into Roof Area
description: Pitch multipliers from 1/12 to 18/12 with roof angles and hip and valley factors. Multiply the footprint by the multiplier to get the real roof area.

title: Square Feet vs Linear Feet vs Board Feet: What Each Measures
description: Square feet measure area, linear feet measure length and board feet measure lumber volume. How to convert between them, with charts for boards and lumber.

title: 4x8 vs 4x12 Drywall Sheets: Fewer Seams or Easier Handling?
description: 4x12 drywall cuts down on butt joints, the hardest seams to finish. 4x8 sheets are lighter and fit up stairs. Seam counts by wall length and how to choose.

title: How Many Boxes of Vinyl Plank Flooring Do I Need?
description: Work out boxes of vinyl plank flooring from your square footage and the coverage on the box, with a chart for common box sizes and a worked example.

title: Concrete Slab Thickness Guide: Patio, Driveway, Shed, Garage
description: How thick to pour a concrete patio, driveway, shed pad or garage floor, what each extra inch costs in concrete, and what goes under the slab.

title: Drywall Screws, Mud and Tape: Quantities per Sheet
description: How many screws, how much joint compound and how much tape each drywall sheet needs, with per-sheet tables for 4x8, 4x10 and 4x12 board and a basement example.

title: Flooring Waste Factor: 5%, 10% or 15%?
description: How much extra laminate, vinyl plank or wood flooring to buy. We modeled cutting waste row by row to show when 5% is enough and when you need 15%.

title: How Many Pavers Do I Need for a Patio?
description: Pavers per square foot = 144 ÷ (paver width × length in inches). Counts for common paver sizes, waste by pattern and a full patio materials example.

title: Tile Waste Factor by Layout: Straight, Diagonal, Herringbone
description: How much extra tile to buy for straight, offset, diagonal and herringbone layouts, why small rooms waste more, and how waste changes the box count.

title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a 10x10 Slab at 4 Inches?
description: A 10x10 foot concrete slab at 4 inches thick requires 1.23 cubic yards or 56 bags of 80 lb concrete mix (75 bags of 60 lb mix) with a 10% waste buffer.

title: Deck Post Sizing: When 4x4 Is Allowed vs When Code Requires 6x6
description: Compare 4x4 vs 6x6 deck support posts under IRC building codes. Maximum allowed heights, tributary load tables, and beam notch requirements.

title: Crushed Stone vs Pea Gravel: Which Stays in Place for Walkways?
description: Compare crushed stone vs pea gravel for driveways and walkways. Understand angular interlocking, shifting under tires, compaction, and tonnage per 100 sq ft.

title: How Many Bags of Concrete Do You Need per Fence Post?
description: Bags of concrete per fence post by hole size and depth, for 4x4 and 6x6 posts, with the formula, a worked example for a whole fence and setting tips.

title: Concrete Footing Depth and Width: Frost Line & Load Sizing Rules
description: Calculate concrete footing depth and width based on frost line codes, soil bearing capacity, and post loads. Step-by-step dimensions for decks and sheds.

title: How Many Bags of Mulch Are in a Yard?
description: One cubic yard equals 13.5 bags of 2 cu ft mulch, 9 bags of 3 cu ft or 18 of 1.5 cu ft. How to compare bag and bulk prices, with coverage per bag.

title: How to Measure an L-Shaped Room (and Other Odd Shapes)
description: Measure the square footage of L-shaped and irregular rooms by splitting them into rectangles, with diagrams, formulas for odd shapes and a worked example.
